# House Log

One heading, many unrelated bullets. This is the shape the flat-list chunking
rule exists for: packed to a token target, these twelve lines become one
embedding averaging twelve subjects, and a query about any one of them competes
with the other eleven.

## Log

- Replaced the bathroom extractor fan, 62.00, Marlowe MF100T
- Loft hatch hinge has dropped and needs packing out before winter
- Bought a replacement key for the side gate padlock, cut at the market
